Commentary.Commentary: Jonny Bairstow was the lone warrior for the tourists with 89 and he got some support from Stokes and Buttler but that was it. India kept applying the pressure and it worked for them. India will know first innings could be match defining and will hope to bat big here. Let's see how they go. Stay tuned for their first hit with the bat.

So it has taken only around 15 mins, 3 overs and 5 balls to be precise for India to wrap up the England innings. Shami picked up both the wickets and was the best for India taking 3/63. Umesh, Jayant, Ashwin chipped in with a couple of wickets each. India will be delighted with their work despite having lost the toss. England will know that they have squandered a good chance. There were many soft dismissals for them and their task is cut out from here on.

OUT! Batty reviews in vain! Shami bowls it on a length on off, comes in a touch, Batty plays across the line and is beaten. He is rapped on the back leg. The players go up in an appeal and the umpire upholds it. Batty wants a review though. Replays confirm there was no bat there and Ball Tracker shows three reds and that is it for Batty. Shami has a couple of wickets today. ENGLAND BOWLED OUT FOR 283!
Batty has been given out lbw, he wants a review though.

Shorter length on middle, Anderson comes down a touch, backs away and pulls it through mid-wicket. Pujara almost ambles after it. He slides to stop, fumbles but thankfully keeps the ball in play. Three runs taken.
Fuller outside off, Anderson throws his bat at it, gets it through backward point for a couple of runs.
Bowls it on the stumps, Anderson keeps it out in time.
Fuller but angling on the pads, Batty fails to clip it through. They cross for a lg bye.
Reverse sweep! Outside off, Anderson goes for the reverse sweep and he gets it towards third man for a couple of runs.
Drives this one through mid off for a single.
On the pads, Batty fails to clip it through to the leg side.
EDGED! Flatter one outside off, Batty drives but gets an outside edge which falls short of Rahane at first slip.
Keeps it a touch short, Batty almost chops it onto the stumps.
Fuller on off, driven back to the bowler who goes to his left and stops it.

Angles it on a length on the stumps, Anderson looks to work it through but seems to have missed it. There is an appeal for lbw but there seemed to be some bat involved there. The ball runs past backward point and they cross for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Off the mark! Good length outside off, Anderson pokes at it and gets an outside edge which runs down to the third man fence. He did open the face of the bat but it went finer than he thought.
Shorter length again on off, Anderson ducks under it easily.
Shorter length but down the leg side, easily left alone by Anderson.
Shorter one outside off, Anderson gets out of the way in time and lets it go through.
JAMES ANDERSON is the last man in.

OUT! WHAT A PEACH! Shami bowls it on a length outside off, the ball pitches and moves away a touch, just enough to get the outside edge of Rashid and the ball carries nicely through to the keeper. He didn't walk off at first since the umpire did not rule him out. The bowler continued to appeal, Batty asked if Rashid wanted to review to which  the former refused and then walked off. Brilliant start for India, the dangerman departs since Rashid could have easily scored a few early.
MOHAMMED SHAMI to bowl from the other end. There is a short leg in place.
Batty is right forward to keep this out.
Floated on off, pushed back down the wicket.
The Barmy Army is up and cheering their side.
Bowls it on off, Batty is right forward in defense.
Bowls the arm ball on middle, Batty stays back and defends it.
On off, Batty comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Floated outside off, Batty drives it towards covers from his crease.
Game time! The players are out in the middle. ADIL RASHID and GARETH BATTY stride out to bat. RAVINDRA JADEJA to bowl first up. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Not a 268/8 pitch reckons Sunil Gavaskar. He adds that the cracks have not opened up at all, there are plenty of runs on offer. The odd ball will bounce. Nasser Hussain with him mentions that there are a few rock-hard plates which have held the pitch together. There has been some uneven bounce with some smaller plates which are starting to open up a touch. Gavaskar opines that the cracks will open up only by the evening or tomorrow. Hussain mentions that there will be reverse on offer with the conditions being dry and the bare ends on the pitch. Ends up saying that reverse swing could keep England interested all the while.

Indians will be happy with their work so far. They will want to wrap things up as soon as possible and get batting since the pitch is showing signs of deterioration. They have a reshuffled batting order and it should be interesting to see how they go about their work.  Stay tuned for all the action from the game.

Cricket has to go on though, coming to the game. England won a crucial toss but some tight bowling from India ensured they could not run away with the match. The English were rescued by Jonny Bairstow who hit a gritty 89. India were fairly generous too with their fielding yesterday but they got the job done in the end. England still have two wickets left and will want to add as many as possible since it could be the difference between the two teams.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of Day 2 of the third Test between India and England at the Punjab Cricket Association Stadium, Mohali. While we wait for the game to begin, let's take a moment to remember Phillip Hughes who passed away on this day, two years ago. It is at times like these when you realize how cruel a sport could be. It was a moment which had an impact on the entire cricket community. A reminder to all of us about the fragility of a human life. We all miss you Phil. Prayers with his family and friends.
DAY 2... SESSION 1....

England will feel that they have thrown away the advantage after winning a crucial toss. Their top half, barring Hameed, played loose shots to get out and had India held on to their catches, things could have been even worse. So far, the pitch has played well. Odd balls have misbehaved but altogether it's a good surface to bat on. However, it's going to get tough as the game progresses. India's plan tomorrow will be to bundle out England quickly and then bat solidly. Do join us at 0930 IST for all the action from day 2. Cheers!

Jonny Bairstow batted beautifully but was unfortunate not to get a deserving century. India were hot and cold with the ball today, however they managed to pick wickets at regular intervals. Their fielding though was pretty substandard. England bat deep and would still be aiming to stretch their first innings total to 300.

An absorbing day of Test cricket! Both teams had their fair share of moments. India started poorly by dropping catches but England also contributed by playing some reckless shots. Once again the lower order came to their rescue. Stokes and Bairstow led the revival with a handy partnership, followed by a couple of more useful stands.
Mohammed Shami pitches it up on off, Adil Rashid presses forward and blocks it out solidly. That's it for the day, IT IS STUMPS ON DAY 1!
Stump to stump bowling this from Shami. Nice and full, the batsman defends it down the track.

It would have been a simple catch had FSL been in place there. This one rises off the deck, Rashid tries to fend it away, it hits the splice and falls in the vacant short leg region. The fielder was a bit deep not sure what would you call that position, but maybe short mid-wicket.
Angling in on middle, Adil works it past mid on for a couple.
Short of a length ball on off, defended from within the crease.
Fuller and curling back in, Rashid gets across and defends.
Gareth Batty is the next man in, replacing Woakes!

OUT! Bowled 'em! Yadav gets his man. Woakes got beaten by two outswingers and now this one comes back in. Hurls it on a length and gets it to nip back in, stays a touch low as well. Woakes looks to defend but the ball goes through his defense and hits the off stick. Umesh Yadav throws a kiss skywards and looks a relieved man.
Angles it away from off, Chris once again tries to play inside the line but gets beaten comprehensively.
Beaten! Yadav dishes out a length ball, it swings away as well. He is tempting Woakes to play at it who does so and is lucky not to nick one behind.
Short of a length ball on off, Woakes defends it down solidly.
Angles in a length ball on off, Woakes defends it from within the crease.

FOUR! Beautiful! Yadav serves a full length delivery on off, right in Woakes' zone. He leans into it and drives it beautifully through covers. Through the gap and away she goes for a blazing boundary. No need to run for those.
AR lets the ball go outside his off stump.
On a length and nips back in, Rashid stays inside the line and defends it down.
Fuller in length and outside off, Adil drives it straight to the man at mid off.
In the channel outside off, Rashid shoulders his arms to that one.
Good length ball on middle, Rashid defends it down.
On a length and moves away a touch, Rashid doesn't play at it.
Mohammed Shami is back on as well.
Swings in sharply from around off, Chris defends it down nicely.
Sprays it down the leg side, Woakes looks to pull but misses.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Fuller and curling back in, Rashid clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller in length on off, Chris looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge past backward point for a single.
On a length and outside off, Woakes taps it towards the off side with soft hands.
Second new ball has been taken 6 overs late. And Umesh Yadav to have a go with the new cherry first.
Touch short and outside off, Adil stays put and punches it towards the off side.
Slider around off, Rashid doesn't play at it.
Fuller on the stumps, it's driven back to JY.
Loopy ball around off, blocked down gently.
Rashid gets back to cut it on the off side but gets beaten by the lack of bounce.
Flatter one around middle, Rashid hangs back in defense.
Loopy ball around off, Rashid looks to push it through the line but gets an outside edge towards backward point for a single.
Drifting in from outside off, Rashid shows his calm and lets it go.
Tossed up ball around off, pushed towards covers.
Woakes comes down the track and knocks it down to long on for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Gets back in the crease and defends.
Similar ball around off, Adil leaves it alone.
Rashid plays for the turn but there isn't any and gets beaten.

OUT! Gone next ball! Jayant Yadav says I will remove Bairstow all by myself. Comes from around the wicket and bowls a loopy ball around middle, it turns in a bit as Bairstow presses forward to defend. Is beaten by the in-ward turn there and is rapped on the pads right in front of the stumps. A loud appeal follows and umpire Erasmus rules it out. Jonny opts for the review and replays show it was in line and would have crashed into the stumps. The decision stays as it is and Bairstow misses out on a deserving ton here.
Bairstow is given out LBW and it looks dead plumb. However, he immediately takes the review and the only thing that can save him will be an inside edge. Is there one? Let's wait and find out.

Edged and dropped! Parthiv Patel the culprit again. He has dropped him earlier and does once again. No impressive at all. Tossed up ball from around the wicket, skids in and stays low as well. Bairstow comes forward to defend but gets a thick edge and Parthiv behind the stumps fails to collect it. The ball goes off the keeper's pads and dies down. Another chance goes down abegging. How much will this cost the home side?
Jonny comes forward to push it through the off side but gets it off the inner part of the bat towards mid-wicket for a single.
Stays back it wrists it through the leg side for a single.
Pushes it slower through the air around off, Woakes prods forward in defense.
FOUR! Crunched! Ashwin drops it short outside off, Woakes doesn't miss out on it. Camps back and punches it behind point for a boundary.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Loopy ball around off, turning in, Woakes gets back to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads and the ball dies down.
Around middle and leg, turned towards mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR BYES! What was Pujara doing? He should have at least stopped this one if not Patel. Ashwin slips this one wide down the leg side, Jonny looks to pull this but the ball is too wide for him. Poor Patel couldn't get there with a dive to his left and Pujara at leg gully is very late in reacting. It races away to the fence behind.
Tossed up ball outside off, pushed towards covers.
Spins in and stays low but Woakes still manages to block it out.
Flighted delivery around off, CW jams it out on the off side.
Tossed up ball around off, swept again towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Swept away! Loopy ball around middle and off, Bairstow gets down on one knee and nails the sweep through square leg for a boundary. Really came off the meat of the bat.
Around middle and off, Bairstow stays back in defense.
Full flighted on off, defended off the front foot to the end the over.
Nicely tossed up ball outside off, Woakes covers the line with a big stride and leaves it alone.
Strides forward to a full ball and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Slower through the air and full outside off, staying low, Woakes gets back, keeps his eyes on the ball and pushes it towards covers.
Lunges to a full ball and defends it off the outer half of the bat. It runs wide of first slip and they cross for a single.
Full floated ball on off, played from the crease and with the spin to mid-wicket.
Second new ball is available now but India have not opted for it. They have brought Ravichandran Ashwin back into the attack!
Woakes covers the line and blocks.
Tossed up around middle and off, defended off the front foot.
Fuller on the stumps, Jonny sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

Just wide of leg gully! Tossed up ball around middle and leg, Bairstow looks to flick but gets it very fine towards leg gully where Pujara dives to his left but the ball goes wide of him and they take a couple.
Comes down the track and drives it towards long on for a single.
Woakes nicely comes forward and blocks.
Darted in on middle and leg, Jonny clips it behind square on the leg side and comes back for the second quickly. Really good running but it's risky as well.
Outside off, played towards point off the front foot.
Opens the face of the bat and drives it towards cover-point.
Low full toss on off, driven back to Jadeja.
Tossed up on off, pushed with soft hands towards the off side.

NOT OUT! Tossed up ball around off, Bairstow pushes it behind point and wanted two always. He is running to the danger end as a flat throw comes in to Parthiv who takes the bails off. He appeals and is taken upstairs. Replays show he is fine. Two runs picked up.
A run out appeal is taken upstairs. Looks safe though...
Brings his bat and pad together and defends.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Around middle and off, turning in sharply, Chris gets back and pushes it towards point.

Loopy ball around off, stays a bit low as well. Woakes tries to sweep it but misses it completely. Parthiv behind the stumps collects the ball and whips the bails off. They appeal but the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays show Woakes is fine.
A stumping appeal has been referred upstairs!
Tossed up ball around off, Woakes defends it down gently.
Tossed up ball around off, gripping through the surface, Bairstow gets back and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
A slip and short leg in place.
Jayant Yadav is brought back into the attack!
Bowls it full and on off, Woakes gets on the front foot and defends it watchfully.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Floated ball on off, Bairstow dabs it wide of first slip for a single.
Bairstow has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

It's a no ball. Jadeja loses his grip on the ball and sprays it outside off. It reaches to the other end on a couple of bounces. Bairstow initially thinks about hitting it but then leaves it with a smile. The umpire has called it a no ball.
India have one more referral left and England two. Reviews will be refreshed after 80 overs, anyway.

NOT OUT! Missing leg. Jadeja tosses it up in the air and lands it around middle, it skids on with the angle after pitching and strikes Bairstow on the front pad as he fails to defend. They appeal but the umpire shakes his head. India opt for the referral and the replays show that it's missing leg.
Shout for an lbw. Not given. India have taken the referral.
Floated full ball on off, Bairstow defends it off his front foot.
The umpires are changing the ball which appears to have lost its shape. Meanwhile, they have called for drinks.
Fullish on middle, pushed off the front foot to mid on.
Full and angling in around off, Woakes defends it back with a straight bat.
Once again bowls it full and on off, Chris defends it off his front foot to point.
FOUR! Quality shot! Yadav overpitches it outside off, 141 kph, Woakes leans into the drive and crunches it through point for a boundary.
Lands it full and around off, angling in, Woakes defends it by getting forward.
False shot! Short and wide outside off, Woakes chases it away from his body, tries to cut but fails to connect.
Flattish around middle, tucked behind square on the leg side for a single.

Ashwin is having a horror time in the field! Loopy ball around off, Woakes comes down the track and drives it through covers. Ashwin comes running to his left, tries to stop it but there is a bad bounce as the ball goes through. Two runs taken.
Pushes it slower through air, at 80 kph, Woakes hangs back in defense.
Gets behind the line and defends.
Loopy ball around middle, turning away a bit, Woakes gets squared up a bit but still manages to keep it out on the off side.
Tossed up ball around off, pushed off the front foot towards covers.
Fuller on the stumps, Woakes flicks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Fuller in length and around off, Woakes comes forward a bit and drives it towards short extra cover.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
On a length and just outside off, Woakes prods forward to defend but is lucky not to edge that one.
Good effort in the deep from J. Yadav! Good length ball outside off, Bairstow cuts it through point. Jayant comes steaming in and does well to only give them a single.
Fuller in length on off, it's drvien straight to Rahane at covers.
Umesh Yadav is brought into the attack for the first time in this session, replacing Shami!
Very full on middle, Chris presses forward and blocks.
Tossed up around off, Woakes comes forward and defends.
Darts in from around off, Woakes defends.
The Indians are complaining for the ball again. It is going through the 8-shape gauge which means it is fine to continue...
Full and around off, Chris defends it watchfully.
Gets behind the line and defends again.
Tossed up ball around off, Woakes defends it down.
JB drives this towards covers.
Fuller on middle, driven back to Mohammed.
Fuller in length and around off, defended solidly.
Bairstow picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper.
Banged in short on middle, Jonny sits under it.

A loud shout for lbw! Angles in a length ball from outside off, Woakes looks to bring his bat down but misses as the ball raps him on the pads as the ball then lobs wide of first slip and the batsmen cross for a leg bye. They all appeal for an LBW but the umpire says not out. Replays show it was in line but would have gone on to clip the top of leg pole. So, the umpire's call it would have been. Good to see Kohli not taking the review straightaway just as he was doing in the previous Tests. He had a word with Parthiv who said it' not worth taking it. A leg bye is taken.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floated ball around off, Woakes drives it through covers. Two fielders give it a chase but the running between the wickets is really good and that allows them to come back for the third.
Flatter ball on middle, CW hangs back in defense.
Loopy ball around middle and off, Woakes plunges forward and blocks.
Full and around off, defended into the ground.
Touch short and turning away, Bairstow gets back and pushes it towards point for a single.
On a length and around middle, defended off the back foot.
Good length ball on off, sliced through point for a single.
Fuller in length and outside off, Jonny Bairstow makes room and drives it straight to covers.
Outside off, it's left alone.
Angles in a length ball on middle, defended off the back foot.
Fuller in length and outside off, Jonny looks to drive it but then makes an easy leave.
Chris makes a good stride forward and blocks.
Quicker through the air outside off, Woakes leaves it alone.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up ball around off, Woakes makes room to drive but gets it off the outer part of the bat through backward point. Murali Vijay gives it a chase and does well to keep them down to a couple.
Flatter one around middle, defended from within the crease.
Chris Woakes is the new man in, replacing Buttler!

OUT! Jadeja strikes and Buttler has to go. A good anticipation shown from Virat Kohli as well. Tossed up ball around off, it comes slowly off the deck. Buttler runs down the track, isn't quite to the pitch of the ball but still goes on with the shot. Hits it a bit uppishly towards short extra cover where Kohli moves swiftly to his right and gobbles it with ease. He then throws the ball upwards and Jadeja is all smiles. A 69-run stand has been broken and India once again on top now.
Fuller in length and angled on the pads, worked towards square leg for a single.
A length ball on middle, Jos defends it with a straight bat.
In the channel outside off, Buttler shoulders his arms to that one.
Fuller in off, pushed towards covers for nothing.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Buttler looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.
On a length and around off, Buttler defends it down into the ground.
On middle and off, bunted back to Jaddu.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Gets to the pitch of the ball and eases it down to long off for one.
Around middle and off, Buttler pushes it towards the off side.
Loopy around off, pushed towards covers for a single.

Live wire, Virat Kohli! Such a good stop! Tossed up ball around off, Bairstow drives it firmly towards mid off where Kohli puts in a dive to his right and makes a lovely stop. He then gets up and quickly throws the ball towards the keeper.
Fuller and angling on middle, nudged towards square leg by Jonny. With that he will keep strike as well.
Fuller and outside off, Buttler drives it towards wide of mid off and scurries across for a quick single.
Sprays it down the leg side, Buttler moves inside and leaves it alone. Double P behind the stumps dives full length to his left to stop that one.
Touch fuller on off, Buttler lunges forward and defends.
Fuller outside off, Jos comes forward and then lifts his bat to let it go.
On a length and moves away a bit, Buttler stays inside the line and lets it go.
Loopy ball around middle, driven down the ground towards mid on for a single.
Stays inside the crease and defends it down solidly.
Angles it from around off, Jos blocks it out well.
On the stumps, defended down the track.
Outside off, Buttler comes forward and keeps it out.
Tossed up ball around middle and off, defended down watchfully.
Harmless full length ball outside off, Jonny has got nothing to offer on that one.
On a length and outside off, pushed towards covers for nothing.
Fuller and doesn't rise at all, outside off, left alone.
Good length ball on off, pushed towards Jadeja at covers.
On a length and around off, driven from within the crease.
Fuller in length and outside off, Bairstow defends it towards the off side.
Mohammed Shami will bowl from the other end!
Floated ball around off, pushed off the front foot towards covers.
Presses forward and defends it down watchfully.
Tossed up ball around off, eased down to long off for a single.
Full and around off, Jonny prods forward and defends it into the ground.
Darts it full on off, Buttler drives it off the outer part of the bat towards point where Vijay dives to his left and stops it. Just a run taken.
Flatter one outside off, it's left alone.

Welcome back for the final session of the day. Outcome the English batsmen, Jos Buttler and Jonny Bairstow. How long can these two carry on? Let's wait and find out. India start with Ravindra Jadeja...
... DAY 1, SESSION 3...

Since then, the Indian bowlers have tried hard but without any success. Bairstow and Buttler have looked at ease and have taken England past the 200-run mark. They bat deep and hence would still be hoping to post a big first innings total. There isn't much support from the pitch and the home side has to come up with a better game plan after tea. Also, they need to be on their heels in the field and take all the half chances to get back on top in this match. Do join us in a short while for all the action.

113/1 in 33 overs bowled in the afternoon session. A good one for England. The pair of Bairstow and Stokes initiated well and put together another good partnership. A lapse in concentration saw Stokes getting stumped out and soon after that Bairstow was given a reprieve by Parthiv Patel when he dropped a catch and also missed the stumping chance of the same delivery.
Hits the yorker mark around off, Buttler squeezes it through point for a single. TEA ON DAY 1!
Brings down a straight bat to a full ball and pushes it to mid on.

Slower delivery, full and outside off, Bairstow sticks back and tries to run it down to third man. But Kohli intervenes with a dive from the slip region and stops the ball. He has a shy at the bowler's end but misses as Jonny makes it to the other end safely.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Back of a length ball on off, Buttler gets on top of the bounce and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Buttler has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Flatter and outside off, left alone.
Tossed up ball outside off, driven through point for one.
The batsman has played it to the point region. No run.
FOUR! Superb shot! Jadeja serves a flighted full ball on off, Buttler takes his front leg forward and creams his drive through covers for a boundary.
Floated full ball on off, spinning away, Buttler pushes it off the outside half of the bat to backward point. The fielder does well to stop the ball.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
On a length and outside off, Bairstow bottom edges his attempted cut shot to the off side.
Pitches it full and outside off, Bairstow drives it off his front foot to covers.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Buttler tries to hit across the line but misses. It goes off his pads and rolls in front of the keeper. They cross and it's given as a run. Maybe, some inside edge.
Good length ball on off, Buttler goes on the back foot and punches it to covers.
50-run stand between Buttler and Bairstow!
FOUR! Sweet timing! Shami lands it full and outside off, Buttler gets forward and sweetly times his square drive. It races through and beats the chase put in by Rahane.
Mohammed Shami is back into the attack.
Round arm action, full and around off, slower in air, Bairstow defends it off his front foot to covers.
Very full and on off, it's forced through covers and they take a couple of runs.
Gets forward and drives it wide of mid off for a quick single.
Flatter and a touch shorter on off, Buttler punches it off his back foot to covers.
Plays a full ball with gentle hands to cover-point and pinches a single.
Slow loopy full ball on off, Jonny gets on the front foot and pushes it with the spin to point.
Ravindra Jadeja is back on.
FOUR! Shot! Too full in length outside off, Buttler strides forward and strokes a lovely cover drive for a boundary.
Goes full this time, around off, it's driven off the front foot to mid off.
Digs in a short ball on off, Buttler tries to pull but misses.
Full in length and around off, Buttler goes back to punch it through the line but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Very full and outside off, Buttler squeezes it out towards mid off. Jayant moves across to his right to stop the ball but fails to do so. The mid on fielder gives it a chase and does well to pull it back just before the ropes. A couple of runs taken.
Turning down the leg side, eased through square leg for one.
Loopy ball on middle, spinning down, Buttler gets across the stumps and taps it down in front of the leg gully fielder.
Slower through the air, around off, turning in, Buttler goes back and hits it straight to short mid-wicket.
Fetches a full ball from around off and rifles his sweep shot to deep square leg for a single.
Full and around off, it's driven just wide of mid off for a single.
Floated full ball on off, Buttler plays a well-timed reverse sweep but finds the backward point fielder.
Sharp full ball, on middle and leg, it's flicked through mid-wicket for a single. Jadeja is quickly to the ball in the deep.
Fuller and outside off, driven off the front foot to covers. Good timing but straight to the fielder.
Yadav is bowling a good spell here. Once again gets a full ball to reverse back into the right-hander, Buttler tries to defend and keeps it out off the inner half of the bat.
Full and on off, a hint of reverse there, Bairstow goes hard at it and gets an inside edge onto the pads. It deflects towards point and they cross for one.

FOUR BYES! What happened there? That missed everything. Big late movement for Yadav, landing full around middle, Bairstow fails to keep it out and it goes past the leg stump and the diving keeper to the fine leg fence. The bowler deserved a wicket there.
Angles in a full ball on middle, Bairstow gets behind the line and pushes it to mid on.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tickles it off his pads through backward square leg and collects a single.
Floated one on off, Buttler drives it square of the wicket on the off side for three runs.

Not out! Flighted and outside off, Buttler advances down the track and forces it firmly back to the bowler. Jayant collects the ball and has an immediate shy at the striker's end. Scores a direct hit and they appeal. It's referred upstairs and the replays show that Buttler was safely in.
Run out appeal. Referred upstairs.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps it to long leg for a couple of runs. Yadav fires in a good throw from the deep, right on top of the stumps but the batsman was safely in by then.
Tossed up ball on middle, swept through backward square leg for a single.

EDGED AND FOUR! Yadav delivers a full length ball outside off, Buttler goes back to punch it through the line but it catches a fat outside edge and screams right through the gap between Kohli(1st slip) and Nair(2nd slip) for a boundary at third man. Both fielders watched each other as it sped through. Didn't carry though.
Hint of reverse there, full and outside off, Jos goes for a big booming drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Fuller and straighter, flicked off the pads to short mid-wicket.
Full and sprayed down the leg side, Buttler fails to flick and Patel does well to stop the ball with a dive to his left.
FOUR! Slightly edgy! Yadav lands it full and outside off, Buttler gets on the front foot with an angled bat and eases it off the outside half of the bat to the third man fence.
Full in length and on off, Buttler gets on the front foot and defends it to the off side.
Flighted and on off, defended off the front foot.
Full and flighted outside off, driven down the ground but straight to mid off.
Dances down to the pitch of the ball and forces it through mid on for a single.
Spinning in from around off, Buttler gets back in defense.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched back to the bowler who stopped it with a dive to his left.
Too full in length on off, driven off the front foot to covers.
Jayant Yadav is back on.
Fullish and outside off, pushed off the front foot wide mid off.
Drops it very full and on off, Jonny digs it out to mid off.
Angles in a full ball on off, 142 kph, Bairstow blocks it with a vertical bat.
Full on off, 135 kph, Bairstow defends it from the upper half of the bat.
Spears in a very full ball on off, Jonny plays it with a straight bat to mid on.
Good length and on off, shaping in, Bairstow defends it off the inner half of the bat to mid on.
Loopy and on off, Buttler lunges and defends it off the inside half of the bat to short mid-wicket.
Slow spin back into the batsman from outside off, Buttler gets back and defends it to the off side.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Very full in length around off, Bairstow brings down a straight bat and pushes it to long on again. Another single.
Too full in length on middle, Buttler forces it down to long on for a single.
Too full in length on middle, Bairstow sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Full and angling down the leg side, Jonny fails to flick and it goes off his pads to deep backward square leg. A leg bye taken.
Full in length and on off, Bairstow defends it off his back foot.
Fullish and angling in, Jonny plays it with a straight bat and it comes off the inner half. Goes past Jadeja at short mid-wicket to mid on.
Lands it full and outside off, Bairstow drives it off his front foot to mid off.
Full in length and outside off, Bairstow keeps his weight on the back foot and defends it to the off side.
Wrong line, on a length and sliding down the leg side, Jonny allows it through.
Umesh Yadav is back into the attack. Two slips in place. Can he get the ball to reverse?
Quicker one darted on middle, Jonny walked forward and pushed it through mid on for a single.
Flatter and on off, blocked from the crease.
Flighted and on off, Bairstow defends it off his front foot.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Loopy and outside off, left alone.
Tossed up ball on middle, defended with the spin to mid-wicket.
Drinks are on the field.
Loopy full ball and on off, Jonny drives it through the gap at covers for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Flighted and on off, defended watchfully.
Gets forward and forces it to mid off. Pujara is caught napping and they steal a single.
Buttler has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Gripping and spinning from around off, Buttler tries to drive but misses.
Flighted on off, driven back to the bowler.
Slower one, around middle and off, Bairstow goes back and defends it off the outer half of the bat. Rolls wide of first slip and Rahane retrieves it.

Stumping chance missed! Tossed up ball outside off, Jonny gets forward with a big stretch and tries to drive but misses. Patel fails to collect the ball cleanly and Bairstow gets a reprieve. His back leg was outside the crease for a while. In fact, the replays show that there was an outside edge too and it will also go down as a dropped catch.
Full floated ball on off, Bairstow tries to drive through covers but it takes the inside half of the bat and rolls to mid-wicket.
Flatter one, on off, defended off the back foot.
Slower through the air, good loop and landing full on leg, Bairstow inside edges his attempted flick shot on the pads.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Jadeja goes even quicker, 99.8 kph, outside off, Buttler gets back and taps it down to point.
Bowls it with a round-arm action, it's a touch short and around off, staying low, Buttler goes back and defends it back.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Slower full ball on off, Bairstow gets on the front foot and defends it to the off side.

FOUR! 13th Test fifty for Bairstow, 2nd against India! Jadeja bowls it wide outside off, Bairstow chases it with lovely hands and strokes it past backward point for a boundary. A lovely knock by him so far but England need him to play a big one here.
Again slower through the air, full and on off, Jos defends it off his front foot.
Flighted one on middle, Buttler gets back and works it to mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Slower through the air, full and on off, Buttler defends it from the back foot.
Offers the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Gets on the front foot and knocks it down to long on for one.
Jos Buttler is the new man in, replacing Stokes!

OUT! Brain fade for Stokes as he throws it away. Jadeja serves a quicker full ball on off, Stokes dances down the track looking for a big shot, a premeditated attempt, completely misses the ball and Parthiv does the rest in a flash. He played for the spin which wasn't there and it brought his downfall. Ben starts to walk but then there is something said to him. Not sure what? Kohli is shown in the next frame and umpire Marais Erasmus is calming him down. Everything under control. England lose another wicket and this is a big loss for them.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Strides forward to a full ball and drives it to mid off.
Too full in length on off, darted in, Stokes digs it out towards the leg side and Kohli runs to his right from short mid-wicket to collect the ball with one hand.
Full and on off, it's pushed back past the bowler for a single at long off.
Flighted and full on off, Bairstow goes back and defends it to the off side.
Loose delivery, spinning down the leg side, Jonny helps it to backward square leg for a run.
Throws it up short and wide outside off, Stokes mistimes his cut shot through the cover region for a single.
Slower through the air this time, a touch short and on off, Stokes tries to cut but misses. Nearly edges it.
Forces a full ball on off, Stokes defends it at the last moment by bringing his bat down.
Tossed up ball on off, Stokes gets behind the line and blocks it down with a straight bat.
Loopy full ball on off, Stokes defends it near his front pad.
A touch short and darted on off, Bairstow goes back and defends it to the off side.
Quicker full ball on middle, it's clipped through square leg for a couple of runs.
Tossed up ball outside off, Jonny plays a nicely timed cover drive but straight to the fielder.
Draws forward to a full ball and pushes it to mid on.
Flatter and on off, straightening a bit, Bairstow goes back and punches it to the bowler.
Flighted ball on middle, tickled through square leg for a single.
On the shorter side, 96 kph, Bairstow goes back and cuts it to covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
50-run stand between Bairstow and Stokes. They have been in a superb form as a pair and holds the most number of runs in partnerships this year.
Flighted off spinner on off, Jonny sweeps it behind square leg for a couple.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. No run.
Flatter and on off, spinning in, Bairstow goes back to defend and keeps it out off the inner half of the bat.
Loopy full ball on off, Jonny defends it off the inside half of the bat to short mid-wicket.
Shortish and on off, punched from the back foot to short mid-wicket. Another maiden by Jadeja. He is putting pressure on the batsmen by holding one end up.
Full and on off, Stokes blocks it safely from the back foot.
Flatter and on off, defended from the crease to the off side.
Walks forward to a full ball and drives it through covers. Straight to the fielder, no run.
Quicker and fuller on off, Stokes goes on the back foot and blocks it down.
Loopy full ball on off, Stokes leans forward and defends.
Skidding back into the batsman from around off, Stokes goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and on middle, defended back to the bowler.
FOUR! Brilliantly played! Just a shade short in length on off, Stokes is quick on his feet, immediately camps back and punches it powerfully through cover-point for a boundary.
Full flighted on off, Stokes lunges and defends it with an angled bat.
Skidding down the leg side, Stokes tries to work it around but misses. It goes off his pads to the keeper.
The batsman plays a sweep shot. One run added to the total.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shortish and on off, not rising much, Stokes goes back and keeps it out off the bottom half of the bat.
Quicker one, full and outside off, Stokes goes deep inside the crease and defends it.
Loopy full ball on off, Stokes walks down the track and then decides to defend it to the off side.
Flatter and a touch shorter on off, Ben goes back and punches it to the bowler.
Too full in length and outside off, Stokes lunges and defends it to the off side.
Lunges to a full ball and jams it down safely.
Tossed up ball on off, Jonny defends it off his front foot. Off the inside half of the bat.
Floated one on off, driven through the gap between short cover and mid off for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Well timed! Ashwin is on the shorter side, around off, Jonny immediately goes on the back foot and strokes it sweetly through covers. Jadeja gives the chase but the ball wins the race.
Slow loopy delivery, full and outside off, tempting the batsman, Bairstow drives it off his front foot to point where Vijay makes a fine stop.
Flatter ball on off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Ravichandran Ashwin is back into the attack.
Flighted ball on off, Stokes defends it back to end the over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Stokes has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Jadeja goes flatter through the air and hits the yorker mark, Stokes digs it out to mid on. Kohli tries to intercept with a dive from short mid-wicket but fails to do so cleanly. No run conceded though.
Too full in length on off, it's flicked on the leg side but straight to short mid-wicket.
Full flighted ball on off, it's gently pushed off the front foot to covers for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Good length delivery outside off, skidding off the surface, 147 kph, Stokes mistimes his shot on the off side.
Rising delivery, Stokes uses his height to full advantage, goes on his toes and jams it down.
Fires across a fuller length ball on off, angling away, Stokes guards his stumps and then allows it through.
Switches to over the wicket and bowls a length ball on off, Stokes defends it from the crease.

FOUR! Lovely shot! One of the best hitters in the V in the game. Sign of an excellent batsman. Shami bowls it very full and outside off, Stokes gives it the straight bat treatment and caresses it to the long on fence.
Flattish and on off, gripping on the pitch a bit and skidding in, Bairstow tries to defend but it takes an outside edge and runs wide of first slip for a couple of runs.
Goes even quicker this time, too full and around off, 92 kph, Stokes forces it down the ground past the bowler for a single.
Relentlessly bowling to one line and quicker through the air, Stokes prefers staying back in defense.
Straighter and faster, Stokes defends it from the back foot.
Quicker through the air again, turning into the left-hander, Stokes remains back in defense.
Flatter and landing on off, spinning in, Stokes goes back and defends it to the leg side.
Bouncer to end the over. Easily ducked by Bairstow.
Bairstow shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Digs in a short ball around leg, hurrying up the batsman, Stokes goes back and fends it off on the leg side. No short leg in place and they cross for a single.

FOUR! Shot! In full control this time, Stokes. Shami overpitches and drops it around middle and leg, Stokes brings his powerful wrists into play and works it through the gap at mid-wicket for a boundary. Nicely done.
Third slip comes in now.

EDGY FOUR! Shami runs in from around the wicket and serves a full delivery just outside off. It shapes away after landing as Stokes attempts to cook a cover drive. But it takes a thick outside edge and speeds through the vacant third slip region for a boundary.
Full and angling into the batsman, blocked with a straight bat by Stokes.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. No run.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Perfect placement. Too full in length and around off, Bairstow takes a positive forward stride and drives it firmly past short cover for a cracking boundary.
Presses forward to a full ball and pushes it to short cover.
Bowls it from wide of the crease and angles in a flighted full ball on off, it's defended off the front foot.
Fine shot! Too full in length on off, it's driven past the short cover fielder for a couple of runs.
Flighted and full on off, defended back to the bowler.

An over-pitched ball on off, Stokes does well to wristily flick it through mid-wicket. Jadeja puts in the hard yards to his right from deep square leg and does the mopping up job. A couple of runs taken to bring up 100 for England!
A gentle delivery, on a length and outside off, a hint of inward shape, Bairstow gets forward and taps it to the right of the backward point fielder for a quick single.
Good length ball around off, blocked from the back foot by Jonny.
Lands it on a fuller length and around off, shaping in a touch, Bairstow strides in to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full in length and angling into the batsman, Jonny gets on the front foot and pushes it back to the bowler.
Mohammed Shami to bowl from the other end!

Five bonus runs! Bairstow gets back and works it towards mid-wicket and sets off. Jayant Yadav gets to the ball and has a shy at the keeper's end. On its way it hits Stokes' pads and deflects towards third man and races away to the fence for a boundary.
Fuller and angling in, Jonny presses forward and defends.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, Ben clips it past short leg for a single.
Quicker through the air around middle, Stokes stays back and shows a straight bat.
Tossed up around middle and off, defended down gently.
Starts with a loopy ball around off, Stokes prods forward and blocks.

Welcome back for the afternoon session. There is some turn on offer but not that threatening enough as of now. Out walk the English batsmen, Jonny Bairstow and Ben Stokes. India begin with Ravindra Jadeja after lunch. Let's play...
...DAY 1, SESSION 2...

Though this is India's session, they need to field well. Their fielding let them down in the previous Tests and they have not made any improvement in this game too. They have to rectify it sooner than later. Will we see the English middle order steadying the ship? Or will the home side run through with the cherry? Join us back at 1210 IST for the post-lunch session.

Jayant Yadav then sent the man in form Joe Root back and Cook couldn't do much as Ravichandran Ashwin showed him the way to the pavilion on his very first ball and made up for the dropped catch. Moeen Ali and Bairstow then tried to calm things down by nudging around and the former even struck a few lusty blows as well but just before lunch Kohli brought Shami back into the attack who got rid of Moeen. Ben Stokes has just come out to the middle and England really need to bat well if they are to post a decent first innings total.

A perfect start for India after losing the toss on a chilly morning. Alastair Cook got what he wanted but things didn't go according to the plan. India didn't start off well as they gave two reprieves to the English skipper and it seemed like he would make the home side pay for it. Umesh Yadav provided the first breakthrough when he got one delivery to shoot up and that spelled the end for the young Haseeb Hameed.
Fuller on the stumps, Jonny Bairstow drives it back to Shami. Bairstow shouts WAIT ON and with that it's LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Fuller and angling in, clipped towards Ashwin at mid on.
Beaten! On a length and it zips through the surface. Bairstow tries to poke at it and is lucky not to nick one behind to the keeper.
Fuller in length and around off, Jonny drives it towards short extra cover.
Back of a length ball on off, Bairstow chops it on the off side.
Good length ball on off, Bairstow looks to defend but gets an outside edge which falls short of Rahane at gully.
Floated ball around off, Stokes draws forward and keeps it out.
Ben Stokes presses forward to this loopy ball around off, it's defended down.
Stokes shuffles a bit and defends it in front of silly point.
Loopy ball around middle and off, Ben defends it off the front foot.
Gets behind the line and defends.
FOUR! Flattish through the air around middle, Stokes gets back and flicks it through mid-wicket. Shot was good and it was equally backed by the outfield.
Angles in a length ball on off, Jonny stays back and defends.
Shortish on off, pushed towards covers.
Length ball, stays a bit low, Stokes works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Ben Stokes is the new man in, replacing Ali!

OUT! Shami strikes and the change of bowling has worked for India. Kohli is absolutely delighted and why won't he be? Shami hits the deck hard and it jumps on Moeen who tries to go for the pull. He is cramped for room but still goes after it. A top edge balloons towards fine leg where Vijay takes a safe catch. Kohli charges towards him and gives him a pat on the back.
Good length ball on middle, defended from within the crease.
Comes in from around the wicket, angles in a length ball outside off, Ali tries to poke at it but gets beaten.
Mohammed Shami is back into the attack!
Gets to the pitch of the ball and eases it down to long off for a single.
Around middle and off, Moeen hangs back and blocks.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Slows it through the air around off, Ali prods forward in defense.
Driven down to mid on for a single.
Tossed up ball around middle and off, Jonny defends it down.
On middle and leg, Ali nudges it towards the leg side.
Gets back and tucks it towards backward square leg for a single.
Outside off, turning in, Bairstow gets back and flicks it towards the leg side.
Tossed up ball around middle and off, defended from within the crease.
Flattish through the air around middle, JB hangs back in defense.

FOUR! That's nicely done! Yadav bowls a loopy ball around off, turning in as well. Bairstow gets down and across to play the paddle sweep. He connects it well and the ball rolls towards fine leg. Vijay comes running to his right, puts in a dive but that is really sloppy. He got to the ball and could have done better. Kohli is not happy with it and immediately asks Murali to come at mid off.
Floated ball around off, Ali buries it into the ground.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Slower through the air around middle and off, Ali comes forward and defends it on the leg side.
Bairstow flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball around off, pushed towards long off for a single.
Tossed up delivery around middle, worked towards the leg side.
Loopy ball around off, skids in with the angle, Jonny tries to defend but gets beaten completely.
On middle and leg, flicked towards mid on for a single.

SIX! That's huge and even better! Yadav once again tosses it up around middle and off, Moeen Ali jumps down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and goes bang over long off for a maximum. He is taking the attack to the bowler.
FOUR! That's a lovely shot! Loopy ball around middle and off, Ali skips down the track and hits it for a one bounce boundary towards long on. Good shot!
Gets behind the line and defends.
Comes down the track and blocks.
Around middle and leg, whipped towards mid-wicket.
Flatter one around middle, punched back to Ash.
Full and around middle, nudged towards square leg for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Ashwin pushes it quicker through the air outside off, Ali looks to cut this one at first but then at the last moment decides against it and lets it go.
Quicker one outside off, Ali makes a watchful leave.

FOUR! That's a gorgeous shot! Loops it up around off, Bairstow takes full toll of it as he makes room and drives it exquisitely through covers. Ashwin at short extra cover puts in a dive but to no avail. The ball sped away to the fence.
Floated ball outside off, Bairstow sees the flight and his eyes lit up. He goes for a booming drive but gets an inside edge towards fine leg. Two runs taken.
Flattish ball around middle and leg, Bairstow flicks it through the leg side for a brace.
Full and around off, defended into the ground.

Loopy ball around middle and leg, Bairstow gets back and flicks it through backward square leg. Vijay comes in from fine leg and does well to stop the ball. He is struggling with his back but still puts in a superb effort to keep them down to a couple.
Quicker through the air and just around the off pole, Bairstow makes a watchful leave to the keeper.
Around middle and off, Ali comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls towards the off side.
Tossed up ball around off, driven straight to the man at short extra cover.
Around middle and off, Ali defends it down gently.
Full around middle and leg, worked past short leg for a single.
Flighted ball around off, Ali drives it a bit uppishly towards mid off for a single.
Flatter ball around off, Moeen camps back and chops it towards the off side.
Drops it short around middle and off, punched off the back foot.
Full on middle and leg, Jonny clips it towards short mid-wicket.
Once again the ball turns in from outside off, JB gets back and offers a straight bat.
Loopy ball around off, turning in sharply as Bairstow gets back and punches it back to Jayant.
Floats it up around off, Bairstow lunges forward in defense.
Skids in from around off, Bairstow looks to punch it through the off side but gets beaten.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Moeen presses forward and pushes it towards covers.
Drags his length ball around off, defended in front off silly point.
Very full around off, Ali bunts it back to Ash.
Loopy ball around middle, milked down to long on for a single.
Flighted ball around middle and off, Jonny defends it down gently.
Around middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket for nothing. A maiden for Jayant!
Floated ball around off, Ali drives it towards mid off and Jadeja quickly gets to his right to stop that one.
Gives this one a bit more flight and serves it around off, pushed towards mid off.
MA comes down the track and shows full face of the bat as he drives this one towards mid on.
Loopy ball around middle and off, Ali defends it down gently.
Loopy ball around off, Moeen comes down the track and flicks it towards mid on.
Lunges to a full ball and blocks it down safely.
Tossed up ball on middle, worked through square leg for a single. Off the mark!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. No run.
Loopy ball on middle, flicked on the leg side, in the gap and a run taken.
Jonny Bairstow is in next.

OUT! Ashwin strikes first ball and makes up for the dropped catch! He serves a gentle loosener, short and wide outside off, Cook rocks back to cut it through the line but gets a thick outside edge to the keeper. Parthiv makes no mistake and the finger goes up quickly again. Poor from the English skipper. England have thrown away the advantage of winning the toss and are in a spot of bother in spite of dropped catches by India.
Ravichandran Ashwin introduced into the attack.
Tossed up ball on off, a little bit shimmy down the track by Moeen as he defends it to the off side.
Floated one on middle, fuller in length, watchfully defended from the crease to the leg side.
Advances down the track to a full ball and drives it with the spin to short cover.
A touch flatter and fuller on middle and leg, Moeen defends it off his pads to the leg side.
Loopy full ball on off, Ali gets on the front foot in defense.
Moeen Ali walks in next at number 4.

OUT! Jayant strikes gold! Root is adjudged lbw and this is a massive breakthrough for India. He tosses up a fractionally short of a length ball, landing around off and turning in, Joe gets back and tries to hit it across the line but misses. He is rapped on the pads, they appeal and the finger goes up immediately. Root doesn't even think about reviewing and trudges back.
Drinks are on the field!
Back of a length ball on off, punched past Pujara at covers for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, punched through the line towards covers for a brace. 50 up for England!
In the channel outside off, Root shoulders his arms to it.

FOUR! Nice use of the wrists! Angles it on the pads, Root gets across and works it through mid-wicket. Jayant goes after it and Shami comes to his left but doesn't get to the ball. A boundary for Root here.
Root defends it from within the crease.
On a length and outside off, Root looks to defend but gets beaten completely.
Full and around middle and off, Alastair Cook lunges forward and defends it towards the off side.
Flighted ball around off, AC prods forward in defense.
Drops it short and around off, Cook gets back to cut but gets a bottom edge towards point.
Floated ball around middle and off, defended into the ground.
Loopy delivery around off, defended down gently.
Tossed up ball around middle and off, Cook defends it off the front foot.
First change of the morning then, Jayant Yadav comes into the attack, replacing Shami!
Fuller on off, Joe Root drives it towards covers.

FOUR! Sloppy from Ashwin! He is having a tough time on the field. Dropped an easy catch and now doesn't field well. Yadav angles in a full length ball on middle and leg, Root gets across and works it through wide mid on. Ashwin from mid on moves to his right, slides and tries to scoop the ball back but it goes through him. He then gets up but for some unknown reason doesn't put in the chase. By the time he realizes, the ball has already crossed the fence.
Outside off, Joe has hot nothing to do with that one.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
FOUR! That's the shot of the man in form! On a length and outside off, Root stands tall and crunches it through covers for a lovely boundary.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.

FOUR! That's insult to an injury! Shami bangs in a back of a length ball but the line is wrong, it on the leg stump and Cook just uses the pace of it and rolls his wrists on it. The all goes towards fine leg for a boundary.

In the air... dropped! Ravichandran Ashwin is the culprit. He has dropped a sitter, this is going to hurt India. Shami from around the wicket angles it in on middle, Cook shuffles across to flick but fails to keep it down. It goes at a comfortable height towards short mid-wicket where Ashwin comes running in to take that one but the ball bursts out of his palms. Kohli is stunned, Cook survives a scare here.
Alastair has punched the ball off the back foot.
Outside off, Cook drives it towards Jadeja at point.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
On a length and outside off, Cook tries to play at it but gets beaten.
Joe Root is the new man in, replacing Hameed!

OUT! Umesh Yadav draws first blood! There is nothing poor Hameed can do about it. Yadav bowls a length ball on off, it shoots off the deck sharply. Hameed tries to defend it off the front foot but the extra bounce proves to be fatal. It kisses his gloves and lobs up towards gully where Rahane takes a simple catch. They all appeal and the umpire gives it out after taking his time. Haseeb Hameed is staring the spot where the ball pitched and then starts to walk back. My colleague reminds me that Haseeb Hameed got out due to lack of bounce in the last game and this time due to excessive bounce.
Fuller in length and around off, Haseeb defends it off the front foot nicely.
Hameed has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Sprays this one down the leg side, HH looks to flick but fails to do so.
Squared up! Length ball outside off, moves away slightly, Hameed looks to defend but is beaten by the away movement there.
In the corridor outside off, Hameed lifts his bat and lets it go.
Fuller in length and outside off, doesn't rise at all. Cook leaves it alone.
Harmless length ball outside off, the English skipper makes an easy leave. We saw Umesh Yadav getting a friendly warning for running on the danger area, this time Shami gets one.

A shout for LBW! Shami comes steaming in and hurls in a length ball around middle, it nips back in as Cook looks to flick it across the line. He gets a thick inside edge on the pads and the appeal has been turned down rightly by the umpire.
Serves it too wide outside off to trouble the batsman.
Fuller and curling back in, driven off the full face of the bat towards Ashwin at mid off.
Back of a length ball outside off, Cook gets back and chops it towards Jadeja at point. He is everywhere today, isn't he?
Fuller in length and wide outside off, Hameed leaves it alone comfortably.
Angles in a length ball on middle and off, Haseeb stays behind the line and defends.
Very full on off, HH defends it off the front foot.
Hameed was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Third slip comes in place again...
FOUR! Edged and through! Fuller in length and moves away a touch, Hameed tries to push this one through the line but gets an outside edge past the vacant third slip region for a boundary all the way.
Beaten! On a length and straightens a bit after pitching, Hameed presses forward in defense but the ball bounces as it just whizzes past the outside edge to the keeper.
Fuller and angling in, Cook defends it down gently.
Fuller and angling in on middle, Haseeb flicks it towards wide mid on where Ashwin puts in a dive to his right to stop that one. Just a single taken.
Good length ball on off, defended from within the crease.
Fuller in length and around off, Hameed prods forward to defend but gets a thick outside edge which falls short of Jadeja again at third slip. He is in the thick of action this morning.
Length ball outside off, Hameed comes forward and lets it go.
Back of a length ball on middle, Hameed gets across, hops and taps in front of FSL.
Stays behind the line and defends it down gently.

FOUR! Pulled away! Umesh bangs in short on middle and leg, Cook swivels and pulls it towards fine leg. Jadeja comes sprinting to his left, dives full length but the ball goes through for another boundary.
Yadav hits the deck hard on off, at 144 kph, Cook ducks to evade it.

FOUR! Yadav strays this one on the pads, Cook shuffles a bit and flicks it towards wide mid on. Jayant gets to his left, puts in a dive but to no avail. The outfield is quick enough to reach the fence.
On a length and just outside off, Alastair shoulders his arms to that one.
Back of a length ball on middle, Hameed hops and tickles it down to fine leg for a single.

This time it falls well short of Jadeja! Shami keeps it full in the channel on off, Cook plays it away from the body and gets a thick nick and is lucky as the ball falls short of Jadeja at third slip.
On a length and shapes away nicely, Cook shoulders his arms.
Fuller in length and around off, Cook looks to drive but gets an outside edge that dips well in front of the man at gully.
On a length and around off, the batsman plays inside the line and gets beaten completely.

FOUR! Sweet! What a sound it made after meeting the bat! Fuller in length and too much of width on offer. Shami wants Cook to play at it and he obliges. Gets on the front foot and drives it through covers for a blazing boundary. Third boundary of the morning, this.
On a length and around off, AC shoulders his arms. Nice carry there to the keeper.
Gets behind the line and defends it down gently.
Fuller in length and angling in, clipped through mid-wicket for a couple.
Peach! On a length and straightens a touch after hitting the deck, Hameed prods forward to defend but is beaten all ends up.
Good length ball ball on off, HH shows a straight bat in defense.
On a length and around off, Hameed pushes it towards point.
Back of a length ball on off, at 144 kph, Hameed makes a watchful leave to the keeper.
In the channel outside off, Cook doesn't play at it.
FOUR! Lovely use of the wrists! Fuller in length and on the pads, Cook shuffles a bit and clips it through mid-wicket. Through the gap and away she goes for a boundary.
Fuller and wide outside off, Alastair shoulders his arms to that one.

FOUR! Edged and through Jadeja! He didn't even judge that one. This is poor stuff from one of the best fielders in the Indian squad. This is a on a length and coming back in, Cook closes the face of the bat early, gets a leading edge that flies towards third slip where Jadeja moves to his right but is a bit late to react and the ball goes through him to the third man fence for a boundary. Chance goes down abegging.
On a length and moves away nicely after pitching, Cook leaves it alone but Parthiv dives full length to his left, almost near the first slip to collect it.
Slants it wide outside off, Cook has got nothing to do with that one.
Fuller and there is again away swing on offer, very little though. Hameed comes forward and then leaves it alone.
Fuller and shaping away a touch, Hameed makes an easy leave to Parthiv.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, Hameed stands tall and defends it down the track.
In the corridor outside off, HH lifts his bat and allows it to go through to the keeper.
On a length and just outside off, Hameed doesn't play at it.
Fuller and angling in, Hameed closes the face of the bat and it goes on the bounce to short leg.
Umesh Yadav to share the new cherry from the other end.
Fuller and coming back in again, Cook shoulders his arms to that one.
On a length and around off, it nips back in sharply, Cook stays inside the line and leaves it alone. A very good take by Parthiv behind who moves to his right and takes it.
Fuller and angling on middle, Hameed comes forward and works it through mid-wicket for a single to get off the mark.
Length ball on middle, Cook looks to flick but gets it off the inner part of the bat towards square leg for a single.

England are underway! Shami angles this one in on middle and leg, Cook gets back and clips it past short leg. The ball goes in the deep and there could have been an easy three but the batsmen settle for a couple.
Starts with a length delivery and slants it wide outside off, Cook only has a look at it.

National anthems are done and dusted and it's time to get underway. The umpires and players have made their way out to the middle. Alastair Cook and Haseeb Hameed to open the batting for England. It will be Mohammed Shami who will start off with bowling proceedings has three slips and a gully in place. Here we go...
It's time for the national anthems. First England followed by India's.
TEAM CHANGES FOR ENGLAND - Ansari, Duckett and Broad make way for BATTY, BUTTLER AND WOAKES.  FOR INDIA - KARUN NAIR (debut) and PARTHIV PATEL replace KL Rahul and Wriddhiman Saha.

VIRAT KOHLI feels it's a pretty dry wicket so the toss isn't much of a relevance. Feels England would look to score big but at the same time there is a chance they can pick up early wickets. Further says his boys are eagerly waiting for this and it's important to keep the momentum going. On team changes, he informs that KL Rahul is injured and Karun Nair is going to make his Test debut and also Parthiv Patel will be opening the batting with Vijay.

ALASTAIR COOK says they will bat first. Further says the wicket looks dry and there will be a little bit of moisture, so batting first would be a good option. Adds the home side played brilliantly in the last game but his side is hoping to repeat what they did in the opening game - put runs on the board and put India under pressure. On team changes he informs they have made 3 changes - Batty, Buttler and Woakes come in for Ansari, Duckett and Broad. Ends by saying it's nice and cool here, a bit like back home.
TOSS - Kohli tosses the coin. Cook calls it correctly. And as expected, ENGLAND WILL BAT!

England will be under pressure coming into this Test as they are trailing in the series and plus they are hampered by injuries. It's not that they have not shown fight in the series but what will be interesting is to see how they go about in this one. The toss once again will be the key. Stay with us as the action is about to begin...

Hello and a warm welcome for the third Test between India and England in Mohali. The home side after getting pushed in a corner in the opening Test, came back hard in the second to take a 1-0 lead. The momentum is for sure on their side and Kohli's men would want to continue it further.
